description: This file defines a Java class 'Song' that models a music track with metadata such as id, title, artist, album, and albumId. It includes a method to retrieve album art from the media file using Android media APIs.

classes.name: Song
classes.description: A serializable class representing a song with metadata and a method to fetch album art.

methods.name: Song
methods.description: Constructor to initialize song metadata fields.

methods.name: getAlbumArt
methods.description: Retrieves the album art as a Bitmap by extracting embedded picture data from the media file.
